proof.surface: Local Dispatch harness (bun run dispatch:local): the Go server built from this head on Postgres 17 + pgvector with every migration, the HTTP API as an agent session and as signed-in humans alice and bob
proof.command: bash /legion/scratch/tmp/t367/probe.sh (tester probe: issue, ask, comment, reply-to-reply, ask-thread comment, message reply, spec blocks, project document comment/ask, approval requests), output posted at https://github.com/sjawhar/legion/pull/2389#issuecomment-6439006979
proof.observed: 18 OK, BAD count 0. Issue made by the session and changed by alice; a claim and an issue comment leave it. Ask reworded by alice: changed by alice; an answer and a resolution leave it. Comment edited by its author moves changed_at; bob's resolution leaves it. A reply to a reply has the thread head as parent. Edited block: made by the session at v1, changed by alice at v2. Unanchored project comment and ask at v1 stay at version 1 after v2, and a comment at v2 is at 2. An approval opened at v2 stays at 2 after v3 (row approval.version 3, written_version 2). proof.criterion: written_version recorded at insert during the roll, and backfilled for older rows
proof.surface: Postgres 17: the harness database and a copy of the base build's database after base-build writes
proof.command: psql: insert a copied comment row without written_version and with written_version 1, inside a rolled-back transaction; createdb dispatch_roll template dispatch_base, then psql -1 -f 0129..0133 up.sql
proof.observed: The insert without written_version records 3 (the document's latest version). The insert naming 1 keeps 1. Backfill on the base build's data: comments at v1 and v2 give 1 and 2; the unanchored ask gives 1; an approval whose row says version 3 gives 2 (from its ask.opened event); a spec approval gives 2.
proof.negativeControl: The base database before the migrations has no written_version column (0129 is absent at base: ls of its migrations shows no 0129 file)

addedTests.why: A mutation made the ask and comment loaders read approval.version and the document's latest version in place of written_version. Every node-facts API test still passed under it, because each one writes its unanchored items and approval request at the document's latest version. The new test passes at this head. It fails under that mutation and under a mutation of the comment branch alone (cd packages/envoy && DISPATCH_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres@127.0.0.1:55432/postgres?sslmode=disable go test ./internal/dispatch/api/ -run TestALaterVersionMovesNoUnanchoredItemsVersion -count=1).
